title: Towards Geo-Culturally Grounded LLM Generations
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a component of the study. The findings focus on the effectiveness of search-grounding and KB-grounding for improving geo-cultural awareness, the distinction between propositional cultural knowledge and cultural fluency, and the risk of reinforcing stereotypes through search-grounding.
